correctness.rationale: For N>=2, prove the complete graph degree formula d_ij=4(N-1)-|i-j|-|i+j-(N-1)| and the even/odd closed evaluation of sum |i-j| |i+j-(N-1)| by centered coordinate grouping. The resulting exact edge and wedge polynomials combine with p_k=(N)_k/(N^2)_k for k=2,3,4, giving the displayed variance by the three overlap classes. The rational identity is checked separately for both parities; at each fixed N the Gibbs specific-heat identity and finite-state T->infinity convergence prove the strictly iterated limit. A standalone standard-library checker passed 491 exact equalities (including complete direct subset enumeration at N=2,3,4,5) but is supporting evidence, not the infinite proof. No uniform temperature assertion.

value.rationale: The motivating physical source emphasizes the specific-heat curve and gives an exact high-temperature energy mean, but lacks the corresponding exact energy-fluctuation scale. This result provides the natural endpoint calibration Var(H_N)/N->31/18, the full finite-board even/odd correction and an explanation through nontrivial cancellation between shared-edge and disjoint-edge covariances (limits 5/3+67/6-100/9). It is a structurally motivated exact benchmark for physical simulations, not an arbitrary small-case table; it does not promise new finite-temperature behavior.
